about.title: 1. About 2gather
about.body: 2gather is a platform that connects neighbours who need help with those willing to offer it. By creating an account you agree to use the service in good faith and in accordance with your local laws.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.

acceptableUse.title: 3. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You may not use 2gather to post illegal tasks, harass other users, misrepresent your identity, or scrape the platform without written permission. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate these rules.

payments.title: 4. Payments & barter
payments.body: 2gather facilitates agreements between users but is not a party to them. Any payment or exchange is solely between the Seeker and the Helper. We are not liable for disputes arising from tasks.

privacy.title: 5. Privacy
privacy.body: As the data controller, we collect only the personal data needed to operate the service: your registration details (name, email address), the location you provide, and the tasks and messages you post. We process this data solely to provide the service, connect users, and keep the platform secure. We do not sell your data. To run the service we rely on trusted processors (for example our hosting and email providers, and a maps provider for address lookup), which handle your data only on our instructions and on our behalf. Beyond these, we disclose data to third parties only where required by law or where you have given prior consent. Under the GDPR you may at any time request access to, correction, deletion, or portability of your personal data, and object to its processing; you may also lodge a complaint with the Hungarian National Authority for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (NAIH). The full privacy notice is available at 2gather.hu.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of liability
liability.body: 2gather is provided "as is" during this early phase. We make no warranties about uptime or fitness for a particular purpose. Our liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.

changes.title: 7. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
